thesis: Consumer-first telehealth platform now operating globally after completing the Eucalyptus (Juniper) acquisition, spanning sexual health, mental health, dermatology, and weight loss across the US, UK, Australia, Canada, Germany, Ireland, France, and Spain. FY2025 revenue grew 59% to $2.35B at ~72% gross margin with $128.37M net income, but TTM earnings have slipped to a small loss (-$13.24M) as the branded-drug/GLP-1 pivot and Eucalyptus integration pressure margins. After a ~37% rally to ~$30 the stock trades at/above the ~$29.77 consensus (Hold) target at ~533x forward earnings, with GLP-1/FDA/DOJ overhang keeping risk elevated — balanced risk/reward.

drivers: Eucalyptus (Juniper) integration unlocks international scale across UK, Australia, Canada, Germany, Ireland, France, and Spain
Weight-loss/GLP-1 momentum via the Novo Nordisk (Wegovy) relationship; multi-billion-dollar upside if the FDA loosens peptide manufacturing restrictions
Employers dropping GLP-1 coverage push more cash-pay obesity demand to HIMS
Ambitious 2030 targets on global expansion, specialty growth, and an AI/data-driven platform
Operating leverage from platform scalability spreading fixed costs over a growing global subscriber base

base_case.assumptions: Revenue lands within the $2.7B–$2.9B FY2026 guidance (15–23% growth); Eucalyptus integration and the branded-drug/GLP-1 pivot keep margins soft near term before recovering; GLP-1/FDA/DOJ issues stay an overhang but are managed; stock hovers near the ~$29.77 consensus target.

risks: FDA action on compounded/peptide GLP-1 cuts off a large slice of weight-loss revenue
DOJ investigation into marketing leads to fines or business restrictions
Novo Nordisk / Eli Lilly competition and patent litigation blocks alternative GLP-1 formulations
Eucalyptus integration overruns and international FX/margin drag persist
Multiple contraction from a very rich ~533x forward earnings if growth decelerates

catalysts.event: Q2 2026 earnings — first full quarter reflecting Eucalyptus integration and the GLP-1/branded pivot
FDA peptide/GLP-1 regulatory decisions — potential multi-billion-dollar swing on compounded/peptide rules
Eucalyptus / international integration progress across UK, Australia, Canada, Germany, Ireland, France, and Spain
DOJ investigation updates into marketing practices

key_risks: FDA action on compounded/peptide GLP-1 medications
Novo Nordisk / Eli Lilly competition and patent litigation
Margin pressure from the branded-drug/GLP-1 pivot and Eucalyptus integration
Very rich valuation (~533x forward earnings) leaves little room for execution missteps
